states.result: Create only the Pactile-composed/generated projection, record it as managed, and add the requesting Adapter as claimant. A missing external/native dependency receives an InstallHint instead.
Record a borrowed resource and preimage; do not rewrite or delete it.
Bind the capability intent to the resource through the host projection and Middleware Resolver.
Leave the resource untouched and require explicit reuse, rename, or skip resolution.
Keep a retryable plan and degrade only the affected host Adapter.

detachRules: Remove only the detaching Adapter claimant and its binding.
Delete a generated resource only after its final claimant leaves and its bytes remain in a safe managed state.
Never delete a borrowed pre-existing resource.
Do not remove another host's Provider, hook, Skill, or AGENTS.md claim.
